mapper.select: SELECT * FROM provider_media_filing WHERE connection_id = #{connectionId} AND media_account_id = #{mediaAccountId}
SELECT * FROM provider_media_filing WHERE media_account_id = #{mediaAccountId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM provider_media_filing WHERE media_account_id IN #{id} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT f.* FROM provider_media_filing f INNER JOIN promotion_media_account m ON m.id = f.media_account_id WHERE f.connection_id = #{connectionId} AND m.media_type = #{mediaType} ORDER BY f.id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_media_filing (connection_id, media_account_id, filing_method, status, submitted_data_version, task_data_version, remote_status, external_filing_id, filing_time, operate_time, next_action, next_action_at, retry_count, last_submit_attempt_at, last_submitted_at, last_queried_at, manual_updated_by, manual_updated_at, last_error_code, last_error_message) VALUES (#{connectionId}, #{mediaAccountId}, #{filingMethod}, #{status}, #{submittedDataVersion}, #{taskDataVersion}, #{remoteStatus}, #{externalFilingId}, #{filingTime}, #{operateTime}, #{nextAction}, #{nextActionAt}, COALESCE(#{retryCount}, 0), #{lastSubmitAttemptAt}, #{lastSubmittedAt}, #{lastQueriedAt}, #{manualUpdatedBy}, #{manualUpdatedAt}, #{lastErrorCode}, #{lastErrorMessage})
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_media_filing SET filing_method = #{filingMethod}, status = #{status}, next_action = #{action}, next_action_at = #{nextActionAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, retry_count = 0, task_data_version = task_data_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND task_data_version = #{expectedVersion} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) AND (last_error_code IS NULL OR last_error_code != 'SUBMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN')

UPDATE provider_media_filing SET status = 'NOT_SUBMITTED', next_action = 'SUBMIT', next_action_at = #{nextActionAt}, task_data_version = task_data_version + 1, last_submit_attempt_at = NULL, retry_count = 0, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND filing_method = 'API' AND status = 'SUBMIT_FAILED' AND last_error_code = 'SUBMIT_CONFIRMED_NOT_RECEIVED' AND task_data_version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE provider_media_filing SET status = #{status}, next_action = 'NONE', next_action_at = NULL, task_data_version = task_data_version + 1, retry_count = 0, manual_updated_by = #{operatorId}, manual_updated_at = #{manualAt}, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND filing_method = 'MANUAL' AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND task_data_version = #{expectedVersion} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now})

UPDATE provider_media_filing SET status = CASE WHEN #{resolution} = 'RECEIVED' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'SUBMIT_FAILED' END, next_action = CASE WHEN #{resolution} = 'RECEIVED' THEN 'QUERY' ELSE 'NONE' END, next_action_at = CASE WHEN #{resolution} = 'RECEIVED' THEN #{manualAt} ELSE NULL END, last_submitted_at = CASE WHEN #{resolution} = 'RECEIVED' THEN COALESCE(last_submitted_at, #{manualAt}) ELSE last_submitted_at END, task_data_version = task_data_version + 1, retry_count = 0, manual_updated_by = #{operatorId}, manual_updated_at = #{manualAt}, last_error_code = CASE WHEN #{resolution} = 'RECEIVED' THEN NULL ELSE 'SUBMIT_CONFIRMED_NOT_RECEIVED' END, last_error_message = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND filing_method = 'API' AND status = 'SUBMIT_FAILED' AND last_error_code = 'SUBMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN' AND submitted_data_version IS NULL AND task_data_version = #{expectedVersion} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now})
